evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet RPC implementation in transactions.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a signed integer overflow in `listtransactions` that causes a node crash. The PR description notes that invoking `bitcoin-cli -regtest listtransactions "*" 2147483647 1` reliably causes signed integer overflow at transactions.cpp:584 and crashes the node with an ASan bus error.
